description: HPO phenotype frequency profile and organ system breadth for ADMIDX
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

d=requests.get("https://ontology.jax.org/api/network/annotation/OMIM%3A301109",timeout=90).json()
rows=[]
for cat,items in d["categories"].items():
    for it in items:
        f=(it.get("metadata") or {}).get("frequency")
        if f and "/" in f:
            k,n=[int(x) for x in f.split("/")]
            rows.append({"cat":cat,"name":it["name"],"hpo":it["id"],"k":k,"n":n,"p":k/n})
hp=pd.DataFrame(rows)

def wilson(k,n,z=1.96):
    p=k/n; den=1+z**2/n
    c=(p+z**2/(2*n))/den
    h=z*np.sqrt(p*(1-p)/n+z**2/(4*n**2))/den
    return 100*max(c-h,0),100*min(c+h,1)

top=hp[hp.n>=4].sort_values("p",ascending=False).head(22).iloc[::-1]
lo,hi=zip(*[wilson(k,n) for k,n in zip(top.k,top.n)])
y=np.arange(len(top))
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,7.2),gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[2.1,1]})
ax=axes[0]
ax.barh(y,100*top.p,color="#2874a6",height=0.62)
ax.hlines(y,lo,hi,color="#1b2631",lw=1.4)
for yy,(k,n) in enumerate(zip(top.k,top.n)):
    ax.text(102,yy,f"{k}/{n}",va="center",fontsize=7.5,color="#5d6d7e")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([f"{r['name']} ({r['hpo']})" for _,r in top.iterrows()],fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(0,118); ax.set_xticks([0,25,50,75,100]); ax.set_xlabel("frequency among annotated patients (%), Wilson 95% CI")
ax.set_title("HPO phenotype frequencies for ADMIDX (OMIM:301109 / MONDO:0957494)\nterms with at least 4 annotated patients",fontsize=10.5)
ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)

ax=axes[1]
cc=hp.groupby("cat").size().sort_values()
ax.barh(cc.index,cc.values,color="#d68910")
ax.set_xlabel("number of HPO terms annotated")
ax.set_title("Organ systems involved\n(50 HPO terms, 15 categories)",fontsize=10.5)
ax.tick_params(axis="y",labelsize=8); ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
